A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose a new quantization scheme for both activations and weights, that enables neural networks (with or without batch normalization) to work with ultra low precision (4 bits for both weights and activations).
PACT is a novel activation quantization scheme that can be used to train quantized networks with significantly lower accuracy degradation relative to state-of-the-art schemes.
PACT enables neural networks to be deployed on low-power edge devices, such as smartphones and wearables, while maintaining high accuracy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PACT can enable a new class of low-cost, low-power, high-performance neural network accelerators for embedded and mobile applications.
